description: One neighbourhood in detail for a decision: local market (sales, turnover, leasehold share, £/m² medians, growth), the local authority's official UK HPI (hpi: average price by type, 1/5/10-year change vs its region: quote this for how prices moved), £/m² price trend, crime with its offence mix (topTypes, a busy-centre note), road/rail noise, nearby state schools with their standing Ofsted grade plus independent schools (schools.independent), planning rules (home: conservation, Article 4, listed buildings, broadband), when its homes were built (buildAge), householder planning (planning: home works, the share refused, approval by kind of works in London, the Renovation score), council tax bands and a typical bill (councilTax), the IMD decile (deprivation), a ballpark price for a bedroom count and website links. Comparisons are with the area's region (regionChange, regionPercentile: London's areas among London's); londonChange and londonPercentile are deprecated aliases holding the same values.

bad.description: What was wrong, missing or confusing.

intent.description: Optional, one to three sentences you write: what the user is looking for with this call and the criteria that matter, e.g. '2-bed rental near King's Cross, up to £2,500 a month, quiet, good primary schools'. Close Knit reads these to improve its answers. Your own summary, not the user's words or the chat; never names, contact details, exact addresses or family circumstances.
intent.title: Intent

rate_previous.description: Optional: your rating of an earlier Close Knit answer, by the callId it carried. Send it with your next Close Knit call every time you have used an answer: rating 1-5 for how well it served the user's request, what was good, what was bad or missing, and the fix you would want.
